about: Official Naver cafe (ccrumble) articles on the Dimensional Rift, 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-03, captured in evidence/r2026-10-03/04-naver/nv. Shape of evidence/08-extract/BRIEF.md, plus the rift-clears fields (rift_attempt) where an attempt has a level. The guide board (menu 9) is public; free-board (menu 8) articles came back 'not logged in' (errorCode 0004) and are captured as refusals. Several articles embed Naver videos, which the scraper saves as 0-byte images; their lineups are read from the formation screenshots beside them. The formation screen's 전투력 is the lobby power, not the Rift's (see nv:48662).

posts.title_en: (Requested) Rift Rowdy Truck records, levels 19 and 23
posts.summary_en: 롤로노아, a ranker who runs a KakaoTalk info room, posts the decks for the Rift truck at levels 19 and 23 with a clear video (embedded, not captured). Tips: run to the left wall at the start; make Macaron's skill hit the wall so it fires in a line. Deck 1 for a high-star Bari, deck 2 for a low-star Bari with Rye in Bari's slot and a multi-hit pet; both on a gear preset with six skill-haste lines and crit-resist padding (스가6줄 치저 뻥투). He cleared level 23 with Rye instead of Bari. The formation screenshot shows 전투력 4.3G, which at level 19 (15% from 22.00G) can only be the lobby figure.

clears.note: Clear video not captured; Rift power not shown, so no bracket.
Cleared with Rye instead of Bari. Level 23 as a truck level breaks the five-level cycle other posts describe (23 would be the Werehound Princess); unresolved.

posts.title_en: (Requested) Rift Werehound Princess clear video and guide (level adjustment)
posts.summary_en: 롤로노아 answers a request for a 15% Werehound Princess tip (악림 on nv:47362: '망치.. 공주 15퍼 팁좀요'): the conquest gear preset, levels adjusted as in Guild Conquest, and care that Brightseeker gets Macaron's buff. The formation screenshot is the Rye deck at 4.3G (the same image as nv:48662's deck 2). 'Just idle on Rift GingerCraven or any boss that blocks you; what won't break won't break.' Comments: 악림 heads straight to level 13; 크아앙 was stuck at level 8 and cleared it at once, now on 9.

clears.note: Commenter 크아앙 cleared level 8 with the tip; power not posted.

builds.why: Level adjustment as in Guild Conquest so Brightseeker and Macaron line up.

rift: Rift GingerCraven or any blocking boss: idle; 'what won't break won't break'.

quotes.en: For Rift GingerCraven or a boss that blocks you, just idle. What won't break won't break at all.

posts.title_en: Rift Cool Mint clear deck video
posts.summary_en: 롤로노아's Cool Mint clear (video and images not captured: 0-byte embeds). Tip: poke at the front, release touch when Cool Mint runs in and fire the poison damage, then go back down and burst. He finds the Werehound Princess and Cool Mint the easiest. Comments: 'the Rift has recommended power too: crumblehub's recommended × 40% is the 35% cut'; 악림 asks for a 15% Werehound Princess tip (answered in nv:48025).
mechanics: Commenter: the Rift's 35% cut is crumblehub's recommended power × 40%.

quotes.en: There's recommended power here too! Check it: crumblehub's recommended power × 40% is the 35% cut.

posts.summary_en: Main stages, not the Rift: with six skill-haste lines on the right-hand accessories, most 35% stages full-auto; 'doesn't work near the 15% line'. A commenter: the key is having enough power to level-adjust so buffs concentrate on the mains.
Official: main-stage boss Cool Mint used only normal attacks, no skills (2026-09-23). A comment asks whether the Rift's rewards being lower than normal stages' is intended.
